password.title: Msheireb resident portal
password.description: Use your Msheireb resident portal login.

portal_session.title: Sign in with portal session
portal_session.description:
Copy your signed-in portal session and paste it below. It contains your refresh token and contracts; treat it like a password.

Bookmarklet (tap and hold to copy):

```
{bookmarklet}
```

**On a phone (iPhone Safari or Android Chrome), one-time setup**
1. Tap and hold the code above to copy it.
2. In your browser, add any page as a bookmark (iPhone Safari: Share > Add Bookmark; Android Chrome: ⋮ > ☆).
3. Edit that bookmark: name it `Copy Msheireb session` and replace its URL with the code you copied.
4. Open [web-prod.mp-mdd.com](https://web-prod.mp-mdd.com) and sign in.
5. Run the bookmark. iPhone Safari: open Bookmarks and tap it. Android Chrome: type the bookmark name in the address bar and tap the bookmark in the suggestions.
6. When it says Copied, come back here and paste into the field below.

**On a computer**
1. Open [web-prod.mp-mdd.com](https://web-prod.mp-mdd.com) and sign in.
2. Either click the bookmarklet (add it as a bookmark as above), or open DevTools (F12) > Application > Local Storage > https://web-prod.mp-mdd.com > msheireb-auth and copy the whole value.
3. Paste it into the field below.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. If the password is correct, try the 'Sign in with portal session' option instead.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Msheireb portal.
error.captcha_required: The portal requires a captcha for password login. Go back and use the 'Sign in with portal session' option.
error.invalid_session: The portal rejected this session (expired or invalid). Sign in on the portal again, re-copy the msheireb-auth value and paste it.
error.no_contracts: The session is valid but no contracts were found. Copy the whole msheireb-auth value, not just the token.
error.empty_session: Nothing was pasted. Copy the msheireb-auth value (see the steps above) and paste it in the field.
error.unrecognised_session: That does not look like a portal session. Copy the whole msheireb-auth value again, using the bookmarklet or DevTools, and paste it.

abort.wrong_account: That login belongs to a different account.
